simple.meaning: נְשׂוּאָה (nᵉsûwʼâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “something borne , i.e. a load.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 46:1. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְשׂוּאָה (H5385) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נְשׂוּאָה (nᵉsûwʼâh) / H5385 is traced through Isaiah 46:1 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H5385. nesuah [ נְשׂוּאָה ] noun feminine what is borne about ; — plural suffix עֲמוּסוֺת נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶם Isa 46:1 , your things (formerly) borne about in procession (i.e. idols) are now loaded on beasts for exile.
definitions.rootNote: or rather, נְשֻׂאָה ; feminine. passive participle of 5375 ;
